issues.surface: Dashboard › Orders tab › order card header row 1 (late order)
issues.detail: Row 1 holds "#1234 · 11:35 AM" plus the red "15m late" pill, every item flex-shrink-0. In US the row is wider than the card's content box and the card's overflow-hidden cuts the right end of the pill ("15m lat"). In GB ("#1234 · 11:35") it fits. At 1180 and 1280 (3 wider columns) it fits in both countries.
issues.measured: 810: row 1 overflows by 28 px (GB 0), card clips 12 px. 800: 31 px, clips 15 px. Calibration with 2-digit order numbers: 2–5 px spill into the card padding, no clipping. The worst case is a 4-digit number (the truck-level counter) or a 3-digit number with a 3-digit lateness ("125m late").
issues.frequency: every late order on a portrait tablet, once order numbers reach 4 digits (or 3 digits with ≥100m late)
issues.fix: drop the space before AM/PM on the card, or set the time one size smaller (text-base) on row 1, or move the lateness pill down to row 2

issues.surface: Dashboard › Orders tab › order card header row 1 (on-time order, "in 55m")
issues.detail: "#1236 · 12:15 PM in 25m": the countdown is pushed past the row's right edge into the card's 16 px padding. It stays readable but no longer lines up with the price below, and it touches the card edge.
issues.measured: 810: 4–7 px past the row (#1231 +4, #1236 +4, #1237 +6, #1233 +7). 800: 7–10 px (#1238 "in 11h" +3). GB 0 everywhere. Fits with 2-digit order numbers.
issues.frequency: every order with a slot time on a portrait tablet with 4-digit order numbers
issues.fix: same as B-01: drop the space before PM or use a smaller time on row 1

issues.surface: Dashboard › Orders tab › Kitchen capacity sidebar (DayLoadStrip variant="sidebar", lg+)
issues.detail: The time sits in a fixed 40 px column (w-10, text-xs bold). Every US time ("11:50 AM", and "1:00 PM" too) wraps to two lines, so each row is twice as tall. GB "11:50" fills the column on one line.
issues.measured: time text height 16 → 32 px on every row (2 lines). Rows visible in the panel: 22 → 13 at 1180×820, 21 → 13 at 1280×800 (−41%).
issues.frequency: always: every US truck on iPad landscape or a laptop
issues.fix: a wider time column (≈ w-16), or drop the space before AM/PM ("11:50AM")

issues.surface: Dashboard › Orders tab › Kitchen capacity strip (DayLoadStrip variant="strip", below lg)
issues.detail: Each slot chip widens to fit "11:50 AM", so fewer chips show across the strip before it scrolls. Nothing is cut off, because the strip scrolls sideways by design.
issues.measured: time label 34 → 55 px. Chip pitch 52 → 73 px. Chips visible across the strip 15 → 10.
issues.frequency: always: every US truck on a portrait tablet
issues.fix: drop the space before AM/PM, or a two-line chip (time over AM/PM)

issues.surface: KDS › Full (handover) ticket, header row 2 (name · time · countdown), grid layout
issues.detail: Row 2 is customer name (min-w-0, truncate), then the time, then "· in 25m". The 12-hour time is about 24 px wider, and that width comes out of the name. Names that fit in GB are cut in US: "Daniel Fitzgerald" becomes "Daniel Fitzg…", and at 1280 "Chloe Nguyen" loses its last letters.
issues.measured: name loses 18–25 px at every size. 810: Daniel 111/111 → 90/111 px, Fatima 116 → 95, Ava 112 → 87 of 131. 1180: Ava 131/131 → 113/131. 800: Daniel → 86/111. 1280: Chloe 93/93 → 85/93, Daniel 102 → 77 of 111. Same with 2-digit order numbers. The midnight event's "12:00 AM" with a late pill: Fatima 97 → 74.
issues.frequency: every KDS ticket whose customer name is longer than ~10–12 characters
issues.fix: drop the space before PM, or give the name its own line, or move the time up to row 1 beside the order number

issues.surface: KDS › Cook ticket header row 1 (order number · status badge · time · countdown)
issues.detail: In Cook view the 3xl order number is the truncating item, and the time group ("11:55 AM · in 5m" / "11:35 AM [15m late]") is flex-shrink-0. The wider US time takes its width from the ticket number. A Ready ticket reads "#…" (GB "#1…"). A late ticket reads "#12…" at 1280 (GB "#1234" in full). The order number is the one thing a cook calls out.
issues.measured: Ready ticket #1235, number shown/needed px: 1280 GB 71/91 → US 46/91; 810 84 → 58; 800 80 → 55; 1180 91/91 (fits) → 84/91. Late ticket #1234 at 1280: GB fits, US short by 0.2 px, which WebKit draws as "#12…" (a sub-pixel case: a real device may land either side). 2-digit numbers: GB never truncates; US truncates the Ready ticket "#35" at 800 (+4 px) and 1280 (+13 px).
issues.frequency: every Cook-mode board: Ready tickets always, and late tickets on the laptop width
issues.fix: never let the order number shrink (shrink the time instead), or drop the space before AM/PM, or move the time to row 2 as Full does

issues.surface: Dashboard order card and KDS Full ticket › tax / service fee / tip lines (data-charge-lines)
issues.detail: A US order adds Subtotal, Sales tax 8.875%, Service fee and Tip (plus Card fee where charged) after the items. A GB order adds nothing. Every ticket gets taller, so fewer whole tickets fit on a kitchen screen. Each line itself fits on one line. KDS Cook mode hides amounts and does not grow.
issues.measured: +78 px per order (4 lines), +96 px with a card fee. Dashboard card 331 → 409 px (+24%). Catering card 813 → 909. KDS Full ticket 301 → 379 (+26%). KDS list row 269 → 347. Tickets fully on screen: KDS grid 800×1280 6 → 3, KDS list 1180×820 and 1280×800 2 → 1, dashboard 810×1080 4 → 1.
issues.frequency: every US order, on every board
issues.fix: on the KDS one line "Tax, fees & tip $x.xx" (or none: the kitchen does not need the split); on the dashboard card a collapsed one-line summary that expands

method: The REAL operator dashboard (app/dashboard/[token]/page.tsx, with the real AddOrderPanel, OrderCard, DayLoadStrip, EventPickerPanel, EventActionsModal and EventFinishTimeModal) and the REAL KDS (app/dashboard/[token]/kds/page.tsx) were server-rendered with scripts/_render-kit.cjs state patches. This is the method of scripts/screenshots/dash-us.cjs and kds-us.cjs: every useState starts from fixtures, Supabase is stubbed, and nothing reaches a database or the network. The pages were painted in Playwright WebKit with the compiled .next CSS from a 127.0.0.1 static server, at 810×1080, 1180×820, 800×1280 and 1280×800 (DSF 1). Pizza Kitchen (test-truck) comes from scripts/_lp1b-fixtures.cjs in two forms. GB: GBP, en-GB, Europe/London, 24h, no tax line, tips and service fee off (GB seed: serviceFeeAllowed false). US: USD, en-US, America/New_York, 12h, sales tax 8.875% exclusive, 20% tip, 3% + $0.30 service fee, and a 3% card surcharge on the catering order. The clock was Wednesday 30 September 2026 11:50 local (GB 10:50Z, US 15:50Z) via kit.setNow/setDeviceTz/setDeviceLocale. The "Wednesday, September 30th" date line was rendered from Sunday 27th. Order numbers are 4 digits (1231–1238): the per-event counter falls back to the never-resetting truck counter, and that fallback is the longest real form. A 2-digit calibration run (cal2-*) is used to state severity. The orders include a catering basket of 6 lines with a 3-option modifier list, special instructions, an order note and a 4-digit total, plus slots at 11:35 (late), 11:55, 12:15, 12:45 and 22:45. There is a midnight-spanning event 20:00–00:30 (not started, not auto-open), and a day-load series every 5 minutes. In the browser (scripts/us-layout-audit/B-ops/measure.cjs), for every element: scrollWidth vs clientWidth (clip/spill/scroller), and natural max-content width vs the laid-out box to the sub-pixel for ellipsis, because WebKit ellipsises at a 0.2 px shortfall that scrollWidth hides. For every time or date element: line count from the Range rects, overflow past its clipping ancestor, and collision with the next sibling. For every card: its height, header row heights, and the order-number and name natural/shown widths. For every select: option label widths in its own font. GB and US were paired by a format-blind key (compare.cjs). Run with: node scripts/us-layout-audit/B-ops/render.cjs && node scripts/us-layout-audit/B-ops/compare.cjs && node scripts/us-layout-audit/B-ops/sheets.cjs. Sheets: docs/us-layout-audit/sheet-05-dashboard.png and sheet-06-kds.png.
